name: Ricardo Vargas
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, trading a promising career in civil engineering for a wrench and a dream. His family initially disapproved, seeing motorsport as a frivolous pursuit, but Ricardo’s passion was unwavering. He started as a junior mechanic, absorbing every detail and quickly proving his worth with an uncanny ability to diagnose and solve complex mechanical problems.

Over the years, Ricardo climbed the ranks, working across various racing teams in South America before catching the eye of a European outfit seeking fresh perspectives. His hands-on experience informs his approach as Head of Operations; he understands the pressures faced by every team member, from the pit crew to the engineers. Ricardo is known for fostering a collaborative environment and his commitment to streamlining processes, ensuring the team operates with maximum efficiency. His visionary outlook helps anticipate challenges and proactively implement innovative solutions, making him a vital asset to Stake Sauber.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a strong build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally checking the setup of every car before a race.
